category_definitions.formatting: Same quantity/date/text identity; formatting or date-heading inclusion differs.

category_definitions.model_error: Apparent extraction/role/number/unsupported-value error in the supplied inputs; provisional assistant judgment.
category_definitions.uncertain: Insufficient legibility or evidence to adjudicate safely.
